issue:
# Empty list is not properly handled in configure() function

When using the `configure()` function with an empty list as the `default_ignore_list` parameter, the function doesn't properly override the default ignore list.

## Steps to reproduce

```python
import freezegun

# This works fine with a non-empty list
freezegun.configure(default_ignore_list=['threading', 'tensorflow'])

# This doesn't work with an empty list
freezegun.configure(default_ignore_list=[])

# When we try to use freeze_time after configuring with an empty list
# the original default ignore list is still used instead of our empty list
with freezegun.freeze_time('2020-10-06'):
    # Do something
    pass
```

The issue is that when passing an empty list to `default_ignore_list`, the function doesn't actually update the settings. This means that any modules in the original default ignore list will still be ignored, even though we explicitly wanted to override with an empty list.

I think the function should respect empty lists as a valid configuration option, since there might be cases where we don't want to ignore any modules.
